declarations.docstring: An auxiliary type indexed by a natural number and two partitions of that number.
An auxiliary partition-indexed submodule of the displayed module.
An auxiliary natural-number value associated with a pair of partitions.
When the displayed relation between two partitions fails, the corresponding auxiliary type is a subsingleton.
An auxiliary linear equivalence from the displayed module to a direct sum indexed by partitions.
An auxiliary linear equivalence between a diagonal component and the displayed submodule.
An auxiliary linear equivalence between the displayed submodule and the corresponding partition-indexed type.
The auxiliary natural-number value of a partition paired with itself is one.
The auxiliary natural-number value is zero when the displayed relation between the partitions fails.
